content.who_you_are: Marek, 61, retired bus driver, smoked 40 years.
content.why_you_came: I've been getting short of breath walking to the shops this week.
content.your_life: Lives with his wife. Still smokes ten a day.
content.on_examination: Wheeze throughout, sats 92% on air, no fever.
content.how_to_play_it: Play down the smoking unless asked directly.
content.expected_answers: Candidate should elicit smoking history and offer cessation support.
content.candidate_instructions: You are the GP. You have ten minutes.
